title: Gitlawb/zero
claim: Gitlawb/zero — The coding agent that answers to you, your model, your machine, your rules.
why_good: A 'your model, your machine, your rules' coding agent pitched on control/privacy — but the differentiation stays at the slogan level.
value: No clear paid wedge yet; a 'sovereign coding agent' needs a concrete reason teams switch and pay.
risk: Undifferentiated in a saturated coding-agent field; more manifesto than product so far.
pick_reason: The project offers a customizable AI coding agent that can be monetized through subscriptions or licensing for developers.

zh.claim: Gitlawb/zero —— 只听你的编码 agent:你的模型、你的机器、你的规则。
zh.why_good: 一个主打控制/隐私的 你的模型、你的机器、你的规则 编码 agent——但差异化停在口号层面。
zh.value: 还没有清晰的付费切口;主权编码 agent 需要一个团队愿意迁移并付费的具体理由。
zh.risk: 在饱和的编码 agent 里没差异;目前更像宣言而非产品。
